Container.Name: dubarr
Container.Overview: Removes audio and subtitle tracks in languages you don't want from your movies and TV, without re-encoding. Files with no audio in your language are left alone and flagged. Starts in report-only mode, keeps every original in a recycle folder with one-click restore, waits for torrents to finish seeding, and tells Radarr, Sonarr and Jellyfin about each change. Set everything up in the web UI.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Dubarr web UI

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Your movie library. Needs read/write, as Dubarr rewrites files. Map the same folder Radarr uses.
